description: Delegation A/B, harder fixes in a simulated long session: each bug report describes a symptom in a public function, while the cause sits in an internal module that other functions share, so patching only the function named in the report fails the check. About 80k tokens of this repository public docs are pasted first, as in cases.delegation-long.json.

cases.prompt:
Two bug reports arrived for this repository today. Handle them one after another, as in a normal work session.

1. A user reports: semver.sort(['1.0.0-rc.10', '1.0.0-rc.9', '1.0.0-rc.2']) puts 1.0.0-rc.10 first, but numeric prerelease identifiers must be ordered as numbers.
2. A user reports: semver.satisfies('1.3.0-beta.1', '^1.2.0', { includePrerelease: true }) returns false, but with includePrerelease a prerelease inside the range must satisfy it.

Fix each one in this repository with a minimal change. Do not change the tests. When all are fixed, say in one line per report which file and function you changed.

Two bug reports arrived for this repository today. Handle them one after another, as in a normal work session.

1. A user reports: yaml.load(yaml.dump({ a: 'null' })).a returns null instead of the string 'null'; the dumped text has the string without quotes.
2. A user reports: yaml.load('base: &b {a: 1, b: 2}\nx:\n  <<: *b\n  b: 9\n') throws 'duplicated mapping key', but a key written explicitly must override the one brought in by the merge.

Fix each one in this repository with a minimal change. Do not change the tests. When all are fixed, say in one line per report which file and function you changed.
